title: The Kite Runner
author: Khaled Hosseini
summary: Amir grows up in Kabul with his servant's son Hassan as his closest friend, and a betrayal in childhood haunts him. Years later, in California, he is offered a chance to set things right.
readIf: you want an emotional, plot-driven novel about guilt, friendship and a country changing around its people.
skipIf: you can't read about the assault of a child or about brutal violence.

pairings.reason: The author's companion novel about two women in Afghanistan, equally moving and often harder to bear.
Another novel where a childhood friendship and a historical catastrophe shape a life.
A family story spanning generations and borders, with a calmer, steadier voice.
